subject: Expansion request: onboarding 4 apps, new API keys & renewal path
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@pulseware.io>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: roll out to 4 additional apps + renewal questions

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the call this morning — Pulseware had the team demo and the feedback was positive. We currently use Redwood for the "Conversational Assist" app (single API key) and are planning to onboard 4 additional internal apps over the next quarter: Insights, Billing Bot, Helpdesk Assistant, and Audit Sampler.

High-level asks:
- Bulk provisioning of per-app API keys with scoped roles (dev / prod).
- A proposed rollout plan (staggered over 6-8 weeks).
- Pricing for the additional committed capacity and any term changes if we move to a 12-month committed plan.
- Any requirements for SOC2 evidence or secure key rotation for our security team.

Ian (cc'd) will handle procurement details. Would you be able to share a proposed timeline and a rough quote by EOW? Also attaching a short onboarding scope doc.

Attachments: onboarding_matrix.xlsx (xlsx)

Best,
Elena Morales
Director of Platform
Pulseware
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@pulseware.io>, Ian Cole <ian.cole@pulseware.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-11T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: roll out to 4 additional apps + renewal questions

Elena — thanks for the clear scope and the matrix. Appreciate the timeline constraints. High level response below and I copied Ben (sales) to coordinate the commercials.

1) Keys & roles: We can create per-app API keys and scoped roles. We typically issue a dev and a prod key per app and can add IP restrictions or VPC routing if you need that.

2) Rollout cadence: recommended plan is 2-week pilot for one non-critical app (Insights), then stagger the remaining three at 2-week intervals. That gets you full prod by ~8 weeks and gives us time to monitor latency and adjust batching.

3) Capacity & pricing: If you commit to a 12-month reserved capacity for the additional apps we can offer a blended rate with a 15% uplift on top of current usage-based pricing — Ben will send a quote.

4) Compliance: SOC2 evidence + audit logs are available; Monica can point Ian to the exchange where we drop our attestation and sample logs.

Next steps: Ben will draft the quote and Marcus can put together an operational runbook and a key distribution checklist. If that works, propose a kickoff next Wednesday (4/14).

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@pulseware.io>, Ian Cole <ian.cole@pulseware.io>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-12T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Quote: reserved capacity + onboarding pricing (PW-2027-042)

Elena / Ian — attaching a preliminary Commercial Summary for Pulseware's additional 4 apps and the 12‑month reserved plan. This is a draft I want to confirm with you before formal paperwork.

Highlights:
- Reserved GPU capacity: equivalent of 2x current baseline to cover the 4 apps (auto-burst to hosted pool included).
- Discount: 15% on list for the term if signed as 12-month commitment; seats/ingress metrics same as current contract.
- Onboarding services: one architect day + 3 runbook sessions included in month 1. Additional ops days priced separately.

I also added a proposed amendment to the term that keeps current termination language but adds reserved capacity details — see attached redwood-term-amendment-draft.docx (docx).

Attachments: redwood-term-amendment-draft.docx (docx), pulseware-onboarding-scope.pdf (pdf)

If this draft looks good, I can build the formal order form and route to legal for a quick redline.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Elena Morales <elena@pulseware.io>, Ian Cole <ian.cole@pulseware.io>, procurement@pulseware.io
Date: 2027-04-13T08:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quote: reserved capacity + onboarding pricing (PW-2027-042)

Folks — quick operational notes and a draft runbook I'm pasting below for visibility. Priya/Ben — suggest we use this in the kickoff.

Basic roll-out runbook (draft):
1) Pilot (Insights) — week 0-2: create dev/prod keys, configure scoped roles, smoke tests, enable prefix caching for common prompts.
2) Review & tune — week 3: telemetry review, batching adjustments, token-cost estimate.
3) App 2 (Billing Bot) — week 4-5: add KMS integration for prod keys, enable key rotation policy.
4) App 3 (Helpdesk Assistant) — week 6-7: integrate streaming responses, error-handling hooks.
5) App 4 (Audit Sampler) — week 8: run audit logs end-to-end, validate retention settings.

Key distribution checklist (summary):
- Generate keys in dedicated project namespace
- Tag keys with app and environment
- Store prod keys in customer KMS or RP-secured vault if requested
- Schedule automated rotation (30/60/90 days depending on app criticality)

Action items:
- Priya: confirm kickoff cadence with Elena and Ian.
- Ben: finalize OF with commercial terms and send to procurement.
- Monica: share SOC2 link and sample audit log retention policy.

I'll prepare a short runbook PDF for the kickoff.

--
Marcus Lin
Principal Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>

All — quick confirmation after today's internal review.

1) Kickoff: confirmed for Wednesday 2027-04-21 10:00 AM PT — agenda will be pilot scope + key distro plan + success metrics.
2) Commercials: Ben will share the formal OF by EOD 4/15.
3) Compliance pack: Monica will place SOC2 report and sample logs in a shared folder (link below) and cc legal if Pulseware needs an executed NDA addendum.

Shared folder: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/pulseware-onboarding (access pending)

Attachments included for the kickoff: onboarding_matrix.xlsx, redwood-term-amendment-draft.docx

If procurement needs a PO template, Ian — loop Monica and Ben and we'll attach one to the order form.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to the kickoff.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
